card.say: I'd do it in one database transaction. First, a conditional update on the payer's row: debit 8000 cents only where the balance is at least 8000. A retry after a timeout can still hit the unique key, so the client needs to treat that error as "already processed" and re-read the transfer status rather than resubmitting.

Okay, so the unique key on the client ID is what makes the retry safe. One more thing on the server side: I'd keep the transaction short.
